text:
ana (oncall): :rotating_light: getting paged for high tail latency from hosted text-gen 2.0, lots of 504s from edge. saw spike ~11:40 UTC. root logs show queue depth climbing.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2145 · High latency on text-gen-hosted · Severity: p2
ana (nah?) wait typo; ana (oncall): @jamal can you check runtime metrics for max_in_flight and per-worker queueing?
jamal: looking — pushing up dashboard now. initial read: 95th latency 2.3s -> 7.8s, worker in-flight ~120, system max_in_flight config is 100 but we have no effective shedding enabled for this model variant.
sasha: confirmed clients queueing at frontend proxies, KV cache hit-rate down 6%. seems cost-optimized quantized variant is slower on long sequences; fallback routing being used which increases load.
leo: customer impact: Maya, do we have any big customers in hosted plan hitting errors?
maya (cs): just got PM ping from AcmeAI reporting failures for their batch of summarization jobs — they're seeing timeouts. ticket #CS-882. no enterprise reserved capacity.
nana — sorry ana (oncall): immediate mitigations I propose: 1) enable shedding for low-priority requests 2) reduce max_in_flight to 60 for this cluster 3) temporarily disable long_form_summarize route that fans out to expensive model 4) bump per-customer concurrency/quota for any paid dedicated accounts (if they exist) or throttle anonymous free tier. thoughts?
jamal: can do (2) and (1). will push shedding policy that rejects requests with tag:priority=low and reroutes or 429s. issuing command now:```sh
redwoodctl runtime update --cluster hosted-gen-2 --set max_in_flight=60 --shedding-policy='priority=low:reject,overflow=queue:20s'
```
deploy-bot: deploy queued — plan: change runtime config -> apply in 30s -> rolling restart of 10% nodes/minute
incbot: @ana assigned to incident INC-2026-2145. timestamp 11:43 UTC.
nana — I mean ana: jamal, also please add temporary rate-limit on /v1/generate for anonymous keys to 5 rpm.
jamal: adding rate limit:```yaml
route: /v1/generate
limit: 300/min per-key
scope: anonymous
```applied via waf and gateway.
leo: good. Also enable model-fallback policy to route low-cost requests to small-llama variant for non-LLM-critical endpoints. That should reduce tail.
sasha: made feature-flag change: disabled flag long_form_summarize for hosted tier (ff:long_summarize=false) — rollout on edge gateways in 15s.
ops-bot: Alert: shedding policy applied, 1.2k requests rejected in first minute; queue depth decreasing.
jamal: runtime config change done. max_in_flight at node level is 60. observing in-flight drop to ~55. 95th latency down to 3.2s.
maya (cs): AcmeAI says errors dropped but some requests still 5xx. asking for ETA. I told them we're rolling mitigations and will follow up in 10m.
nana/ana: can we also tune timeouts? frontend proxy timeout currently 15s — let's reduce to 8s for user-facing API to fail fast and trigger client-side retries to cheap model. jamal pls patch.
jamal: submitted proxy change:```json
{"endpoint":"/v1/generate","timeout_ms":8000}
```routing updated, proxies reloaded.
incbot: Add note: mitigation actions taken: shedding, max_in_flight lowered, feature disabled, rate-limits applied, proxy timeout shortened.
leo: monitoring: please add temporary alerts for 95th latency >5s and rejected-rate >500/min so we can catch oscillation.
sasha: added alert rules; dashboard link: https://dash.redwood/incident/2162500000
ops-bot: Autoscaling paused for hosted-gen-2 cluster during config change to avoid noisy neighbor spin-up.
jamal: observing decreased KV miss due to fewer long requests; throughput 10% down but tail better. 95th now ~2.0s.
maya (cs): AcmeAI confirms bulk of jobs completed, but a few timed out; they asked for explanation and whether we can provide a partial results export. I offered CS assist and to open a follow-up engineering task.
nana/ana: create follow-up: actions: (A) full postmortem (B) improve model selection fallback (C) automated shedding on model variants (D) evaluate dynamic max_in_flight auto-tuning. assign to eng-runtime and eng-ml.
jamal: leaving oncall in 12m; handing off to sasha. summary for sasha: current state stable, mitigations active, rollback plan: revert max_in_flight to 100 and re-enable long_form_summarize after traffic normalizes >30m for 10m window.
sasha: ack takeover. will monitor for 30m and then coordinate rollback if safe.
incbot: Incident INC-2026-2145 status -> Mitigated (temporary controls).
deploy-bot: logs for command sequence:```text
11:43 runtime update initiated
11:44 proxy timeout applied
11:44 feature-flag disabled
11:45 rate-limits applied
11:47 shedding active
11:52 latency trending down
```
leo: good job team. keep CS loop updated. we'll schedule postmortem tomorrow 16:00 UTC.
maya (cs): thanks, keeping AcmeAI updated.
nana/ana: thumbs. reopening if any regressions.
